summary:
w122 planned: batch-measurement r43 (active in the window), r60 (per-session round trips, tool uses, dispatched, compactions), r61 (show), r62 (compare session totals).
The deprecated r43 scenario is retired and removed from the feature.
Key decision: the r60 figures come from the session's transcript in --sessions <dir>, not the store (rests on r43 'found there' and r60 'its transcript'). The shared transcript Given writes there when the directory holds the session.
Active = any message inside the window; each session counts its own rows only (subagent exclusion, as r53); refusal of unreadable rows per r47 and 0018.
show gains four session columns; compare gains a second table of totals over the sessions.
batch_measurement_world.py dropped from the researcher's set (not needed under the directory reading).
Only the retired scenario breaks; test_measure_runs.py and the r44, r45, r49, r53 steps are unaffected.
Open cases: window bounds, slim-export fields, compaction marker, tool order, old records; defects D1-D3 left out of scope.
